pins.title: 5 Pantry Staples That Make Any Dinner Work
pins.alt: Numbered list of five pantry staples beside a photo of glass jars of lentils and grains. Headline: 5 staples that make any dinner work.
pins.text: Five pantry staples that turn into almost any dinner: tinned beans, red lentils, couscous, tahini and smoked paprika. iEatz builds real recipes from the staples you already own.

pins.title: Cook With What's Already in Your Fridge
pins.alt: Open fridge in warm light. Headline: Cook with what's already in your fridge.
pins.text: Snap a photo of your fridge and iEatz finds the dinner hiding in there — no shopping trip, less waste. Pantry-first cooking, free on the App Store.

pins.title: 15-Minute Dinners From a Single Photo
pins.alt: Giant italic numeral 15 min with a circular grain-bowl photo. Headline: dinners from a single photo.
pins.text: Point your camera at the fridge and iEatz ranks real recipes by what you already have — dinner in fifteen minutes, from a single photo.

pins.title: 5 Ways iEatz Keeps Your Meals on Track
pins.alt: Numbered list of five health features beside a green grain bowl. Headline: 5 ways iEatz keeps you on track.
pins.text: Macros up front, calorie targets tuned to your body, allergy flags, weekly trends and goal-first picks. Healthy meal planning that follows your numbers — macros are estimates per serving.

pins.title: See Calories and Macros Before You Cook
pins.alt: Phone showing the iEatz recipe screen with macros. Headline: See macros before you cook.
pins.text: Calories, protein, carbs and fat on every recipe card, before the first chop. Macros are estimates per serving. Free on the App Store.

pins.title: Eat for Your Body, Not a Generic Plan
pins.alt: Fresh greens prep spread. Headline: Eat for your body, not a generic plan.
pins.text: Set your targets once and every iEatz recipe follows your numbers. Healthy dinners built around you — free to start on the App Store.

pins.title: Craving to Cart in Three Taps
pins.alt: Numbered three-step list beside a shopper checking a label. Headline: Craving to cart, in three taps.
pins.text: Pick a recipe, iEatz checks your kitchen, and only the missing ingredients go to an Instacart cart. Grocery, sorted — powered by Instacart.

pins.title: Never Buy What You Already Own
pins.alt: Fresh grocery haul on a counter. Headline: Never buy what you already own.
pins.text: iEatz remembers your kitchen, so your shopping list only holds what's actually missing. Less waste, less double-buying — free on the App Store.

pins.title: Shop the Gaps, Delivered
pins.alt: Phone showing the iEatz recipe screen with a Shop with Instacart button. Headline: Shop the gaps, delivered.
pins.text: iEatz builds an Instacart cart from just the ingredients you're missing for a recipe. From craving to delivery in a tap — powered by Instacart.
